title: Shipit Quality Gate - Makefile Auto-Detection
description: Shipit quality gate enabled via Makefile auto-detection. Tests now enforced before every commit. Closes gap where shipit Step 5a was skipping tests due to no pytest.ini/package.json/Makefile. Framework incident: commit f7cf94c pushed with 126 validation errors that should have been caught by shipit.
rationale: Critical quality gate was defined but not active. Prevents broken code from entering git history. Affects all spokes with test suites.
